Definition: Total Blocking Snaps : Combined count of pass and run blocking snaps.
Run/Pass Block Snaps : Snaps specifically in a run or pass blocking role.
Allowed Pressure Opportunities : A PFF Signature Stat count. Non-spike, non-penalty snaps where the player functioned as a pass blocker.
Sacks / Hits / Hurries Allowed : Defensive pressure events attributed to the blocker.
Total Pressures Allowed : The sum of sacks, hits, and hurries allowed.
Pass Blocking Efficiency : A PFF Signature Stat measuring pressure allowed per snap, with a heavier mathematical weighting assigned to sacks allowed.
